nativeSourceGate.discriminator: Exact independently verified source ZIP SHA1, using main1.21 and official Hardcore1.21 identity when selected; not arbitrary filename/version-string/pack-format heuristics. Historical fixture/archive hashes continue through legacy conversion.
nativeSourceGate.exactSelectionRule: Compute Utils.calculateSHA1(sourcePack) once before ZIP traversal; native policy only when actual source bytes hash to mainSha1 or hardcoreSha1. Do not select by the updated enum SHA1 alone: frozen historical inputs must still select historical conversion when inspected through test metadata.
nativeSourceGate.plannedChange: In copyForWorld determine native verified source once before ZIP loop. Native mcfunction copies pass-through. Native JSON parse/traverse solely existing announcement suppression; leave all criteria/references unchanged and preserve source bytes when no announcement change. Historical convertJson/convertFunction implementation remains intact. Retain original String-signature methods for existing historical regressions; use a narrow overload/helper for native policy. Compute native identity from actual source ZIP bytes once, using Utils.calculateSHA1(sourcePack) and the two exact SHA1 constants; no filename/enum-only trust.
nativeSourceGate.scope: Main BACAP1.21 and Hardcore1.21 only. Historical variants and all other sources retain existing conversion. No broad metadata heuristic.

optionalMacroConvention.guardContract: Each reward/trophy/experience macro line has score-option and, for first/team modes, obtained/team guards. These are activation guards, NOT resource-existence guards. Disabled options avoid lookup. Enabled absent optional resources yield a per-command CommandSyntaxException; CustomCommandExecutor.WithErrorHandling handles the error and returns without discarding the remaining parent function commands. AdvancementRewards invokes functions withSuppressedOutput. Therefore absence is an optional-effect no-op and does not block score, points, first-obtained or cooperative commands. Preserve upstream sparse reward corpus; no1075 fake files.
proof: FunctionArgument.parse reads Identifier without resolving existence
FunctionArgument.getFunction resolves at execution and throws arguments.function.unknown for missing ID
CustomCommandExecutor.WithErrorHandling.run catches CommandSyntaxException, onError, callback.onFailure and returns; no queue discard
AdvancementRewards.grant lambda creates source.withSuppressedOutput before ServerFunctionManager.execute
Shared macro places count/points/first/coop commands after optional reward blocks
optionalMacroConvention.validationRequired: B10 enable all optional rewards on an advancement with absent effect files, assert remaining existing effects, raw/points/first/coop updates and localized message execute; disabled options skip lookup. Trace failure may remain visible to explicit function debug tracing, so do not claim literally zero diagnostic errors.
